Hours
We are open Tuesday through Sunday, 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. Starting November 1, 2026 the zoo will close at 4:30 p.m.
Ticketed Entry Times
10 a.m., 12:30 p.m., and 2:30 p.m.
Please make your reservation and purchase your tickets online prior to your visit, as we cannot guarantee entry into the museum without an advanced reservation or ticket. We have three ticketed entry times, 10 a.m., 12:30 p.m., and 2:30 p.m. You can arrive anytime after your ticket reservation starts, and stay as long as you would like! 
Tickets are non-refundable and non-transferable.
Parking
The museum & zoo is located at 1451 Middlefield Road, Palo Alto, CA 94301. 
We offer free parking in our lot, as well as free street parking on nearby roads for all visitors.
Bike racks are available for free in front of the museum.
Directions
Members Admission
Members enjoy unlimited visits plus other benefits, for an entire year. Members must make advanced reservations for their visits by reserving $0 tickets online AFTER they have purchased their membership and received their confirmation email.  Please note that Memberships are non-refundable and non-transferable.
In January 2025, a new ticketing and membership portal was launched. If you are a current Palo Alto Junior Museum & Zoo Member, your account information was migrated to our new online portal and your membership number (your phone number) remains the same, you will need to activate your account in the new portal.  
In November 2025, we started to require members to show a form of ID along with their membership tickets upon entry. This change ensures fairness and security for everyone. 
Please note that only the adults listed on your membership account (and their children under 18) are eligible for free member tickets. To use a guest pass, members who are the primary account holders may bring guests upon arrival to the front desk. Please note that guest passes are single-use and will not be restored until the membership is renewed.

Reduced Tickets
Discounted $3 tickets are available to income-eligible families or families with members who have disabilities. Tickets may only be purchased for persons receiving the benefits (through certain social programs), their spouse, and their children under 18 living in the same household.
To qualify for this benefit, you must participate in one of the social programs listed below and be able to present proof of participation upon arrival to the Museum for your visit.  The follow documentation is accepted:
EBT, WIC, BIC, Medicaid, Medical, or CA Healthy Families membership card.
Enrollment confirmation paperwork from Kaiser MFA, Kaiser Community Health Care, or the Free and Reduced-Price Lunch Program.  
It is not necessary to provide proof of disability.

Field Trip Admission
Self-guided field trips are available for school groups of 10 or more on Tuesdays, Wednesday and Thursdays.  Advanced reservation and purchase of tickets is required by emailing funscience@paloalto.gov. 
10 a.m. session - $8 per each student and adult chaperone
12:30 session - $6 per each student and adult chaperone
Scheduling for the 2026-27 school year begins September 1st.
Special Animal Encounters
Feed the Flamingo Flock! Get up close with our fabulous flock in the Wildlife Circle daily at 11 a.m. and 3 p.m.! 
Meet a Bald Eagle in the California Dinosaur Garden on Wednesdays and Saturdays at 12:45 p.m.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is there stroller parking?
Stroller parking is limited and our place is small, so you are not likely to need one. Please consider leaving your stroller at home.
Can I bring my own food and drink?
Visitors are welcome to bring their own food and drink for consumption at the adjacent Rinconada Park or in front of the Museum. Food and drink (with the exception of water) cannot be consumed anywhere in the museum, zoo or courtyard.
Can I re-enter?
Yes, visitors will be able to re-enter by receiving a stamp from the front desk staff.
Please don't come if you are sick. The bird flu continues to endanger birds living in the wild and here in our zoo. You can help keep our flock safe.
